Goodberry.description: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 hit point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

Healing Word.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

Thunderwave.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube must make a Constitution saving throw, taking thunder damage on a failed save and half as much on a success. A creature that fails is pushed away from you.

Entangle.description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square. The area becomes difficult terrain, and creatures in the area must make a Strength saving throw or become restrained.
